prelaunch.title: Pre-Launch QA
items: All page titles unique, ≤ 60 characters, and include a primary keyword
Meta descriptions unique, ≤ 160 characters, benefit-led
Favicon, Apple touch icon, and social share image (1200×630) uploaded
301 redirects mapped from every legacy URL to its new equivalent
XML sitemap generated and submitted to Google Search Console
robots.txt allows crawling and references the sitemap
SSL certificate installed and HTTPS forced site-wide
Forms tested end-to-end: submission, confirmation, and CRM/EHR delivery
Analytics (GA4) + conversion events firing for calls, forms, and bookings
Legal pages live: Privacy Policy, HIPAA Notice, ADA statement, Terms
Broken-link scan run — zero 404s from internal pages
Staging site blocked from indexing (noindex + basic auth)

seo.title: On-Page SEO
seo.tagline: Rank for the searches that book patients.
items: One H1 per page — matches user intent, not brand fluff
Semantic H2/H3 outline mirrors patient questions
Service pages target one primary + 2–3 supporting keywords
Location pages include city, neighborhood, and driving directions
Internal links from blog posts to money pages (services, booking)
Descriptive image alt text on every non-decorative image
Schema markup: MedicalBusiness, Physician, Service, FAQPage, Review
Author bio + medical reviewer on every clinical article (E-E-A-T)
Google Business Profile linked, categories set, hours accurate
Local NAP (Name, Address, Phone) identical across site + citations
Canonical tags on every page — no duplicate content leaks
Open Graph + Twitter Card tags rendering correctly in debuggers

hipaa.title: HIPAA Compliance
hipaa.tagline: Protect PHI on every form, pixel, and page.
items: BAA signed with hosting, forms, email, and analytics providers
No PHI captured by GA4, Meta Pixel, or third-party heatmaps
Contact forms transmit over TLS to a HIPAA-eligible endpoint
Patient portal login separated from marketing site session
Session timeouts + brute-force protection on any authed area
Access logs retained per your retention policy
Staff trained on secure form-review workflow — no PHI in email
Cookie banner discloses trackers and honors opt-out
Privacy notice references HIPAA + state law (e.g. CCPA/CMIA)
Data breach response plan documented and reachable
Chatbots + AI assistants configured to refuse PHI collection
Backup encryption verified and restore tested quarterly

a11y.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
items: Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI
All interactive elements reachable and operable by keyboard
Visible focus indicators on every focusable element
Form fields have programmatically associated labels
Error messages announced to screen readers via aria-live
Skip-to-content link at the top of every page
Semantic landmarks: header, nav, main, footer
Images have meaningful alt text; decorative use alt=""
Video content includes captions and transcripts
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
Tap targets ≥ 44×44 CSS pixels on mobile
ADA compliance statement with a working feedback channel

performance.title: Performance & Core Web Vitals
performance.tagline: Fast pages rank higher and convert more.
items: LCP < 2.5s on mobile 4G (real-user data, not just lab)
INP < 200ms across primary CTAs and menus
CLS < 0.1 — reserve space for images, ads, and embeds
Hero image served as WebP/AVIF and appropriately sized
Fonts self-hosted or preloaded with font-display: swap
JavaScript code-split by route, third-party scripts lazy-loaded
Images use width/height attributes to prevent layout shift
CDN in front of static assets with long-lived cache headers
Critical CSS inlined; render-blocking resources eliminated
Server response time (TTFB) < 600ms globally
No fourth-party scripts loaded by tag managers
Lighthouse mobile score ≥ 90 across all four categories

mobile.title: Mobile & UX
mobile.tagline: 80%+ of patients arrive on a phone.
items: Sticky call button visible on every mobile screen
Menu opens in one tap — no nested hover reveals
Booking CTA reachable within one thumb-scroll of the fold
Forms use appropriate input types (tel, email, date)
Address block tap-opens Google Maps directions
Phone number is a tel: link, not plain text
Before/after gallery loads progressively, not all at once
Modals are dismissable via swipe-down or clear close button
No horizontal scroll on any viewport ≥ 320px wide
Fixed elements do not obscure form fields when keyboard opens
Language of the page declared on <html lang>
Dark-mode brand tokens tested for legibility

conversion.title: Conversion & Trust
items: Primary CTA (Book, Call) above the fold on every page
Secondary CTA (Get Pricing, Free Consult) on every service page
Trust bar: HIPAA-aware, ADA, SSL, board certifications
Real patient reviews (aggregated + individual) with schema
Before/after gallery with consent, filters, and outcome notes
Provider bios with credentials, headshots, and specialties
Insurance + financing options clearly listed
New-patient form under 8 fields; long forms broken into steps
Thank-you page includes next step, not just "we'll be in touch"
Live chat or WhatsApp for after-hours questions
Exit-intent offer relevant to the service page (free consult, guide)
Call tracking + form tracking tied to marketing channel

security.title: Security & Reliability
security.tagline: Protect the practice — and the patient.
items: Automatic daily backups stored offsite, tested monthly
CMS, plugins, and themes on a documented update cadence
Web Application Firewall (WAF) + brute-force protection
Admin accounts use MFA and unique passwords
Least-privilege roles for staff, vendors, and integrations
Security headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP
Vulnerability scans run at least quarterly
Uptime monitoring with SMS alerts to a real human
Documented incident response + escalation contacts
DNS records inventoried; unused subdomains removed
SSL renewal automated; expiry monitored
Vendor list (BAA + non-BAA) reviewed annually

content.title: Content & Editorial
content.tagline: Say the right thing to the right patient.
items: Dedicated page per service (not one "Services" catch-all)
Each service page answers: what, who, how, cost, next step
Location pages have unique copy — no boilerplate duplication
FAQ block on every service page (5–8 real patient questions)
Medical claims cited or reviewed by a board-certified provider
Reading level tuned to grade 7–9 for patient-facing copy
No stock photos of unrelated "models" pretending to be patients
Editorial calendar with monthly SEO + seasonal content
Old articles refreshed annually with new data + internal links
Author bios linked from every post, with Author schema
Consistent voice guide + terminology across the site
Legal + medical disclaimers on relevant pages
